executive_summary.status: Demo/internal use OK - Phase 1 P0/P1 remediation required before customer production
executive_summary.vulnerability_posture: Strong authentication/authorization, critical gaps in rate limiting, RLS policies, and input validation

critical_gaps.issue: 13 high-cost AI APIs bypass rate limit middleware
4 tables lack RLS policies (org_alignment_insights, stage_reflection_candidates, insight_sources, agent_logs)
critical_gaps.impact: Other companies' strategic data visible via Supabase Service Role

critical_gaps.issue: CSV formula injection (=cmd prefix not sanitized)
critical_gaps.impact: RCE when file opened in Excel
critical_gaps.remediation: Add prefix detection/sanitization in candidateBuilder.ts for =, +, @, - characters

critical_gaps.issue: Excel import no timeout or decompressed size check
critical_gaps.remediation: Add AbortSignal timeout + decompressed size validation (MAX 100MB)

critical_gaps.issue: Upstash Redis fail-open pattern (no rate limit when Redis unavailable)
critical_gaps.impact: Brute force, token enumeration, password cracking enabled
critical_gaps.remediation: Verify Upstash Redis config in production, implement fail-closed pattern
